title: Has anyone ever made a game out of tomoaky's danmaku shooter script?

posts.author: SpecterReaper
posts.body:
Hi there, this is a bit of an unusual question, but I'm hoping that I'm not breaking any rules as the project in question is free and unencrypted, it's just the matter of its accessibility that I'm unsure of.
The website that hosted this project,
http://hikimoki.sakura.ne.jp
, is now defunct. However, with the usage of the
Wayback Machine
, it's still possible to download it.
This project included a collection of scripts that can emulate a danmaku shooter, similar to that of the Touhou Project franchise. There was also a version of these scripts made for RPG Maker VX, and someone was actually able to make
a game
out of it. My question is, did anyone manage to do the same for the Ace version?
Apologies for the inconvenience.

posts.author: AkiraKotatsuhime
posts.body:
Just to add something about how to download: Wayback is not necessary, tomoaky has set up a
GoogleDrive folder
for all of their stuff (got the link from Twitter-profile).
～炬燵あ
